## Detailed Project Specifications & Coordinates

### 1. Metro Industrial Park 1 (MIP 1 — Ready Sheds & Warehouses)
- **Location**: Behind Siya Industrial Park, Opp. Suvas Industrial Park, Moraiya, Changodar, Ahmedabad – 382213, Gujarat, India.
- **Coordinates**: 22.9140377, 72.4206651
- **Campus Details**: 54,000+ sq.yards | 63 units delivered | Sizes: 4,000 sq.ft to 50,000 sq.ft.
- **Available Discrete Units**:
  - **4,000 Sq.Ft Unit**: Small factory shed / workshop / packaging.
  - **8,500 Sq.Ft Unit**: Mid-size manufacturing shed with dedicated dock loading space.
  - **15,000 Sq.Ft Unit**: Heavy engineering / fabrication shed equipped for overhead cranes.
  - **25,000 Sq.Ft Unit**: Large-format logistics warehouse facility.
  - **50,000 Sq.Ft Unit**: Regional mega distribution center with multi-bay loading.
- **Engineering Specs**: 30–35 ft clear ceiling height, 60 ft heavy-duty RCC internal roads, 24/7 CCTV surveillance, security guards, industrial water supply, dedicated weighbridge, underground drainage.
- **Commercial Terms**:
  - **Lease**: 5–10 year corporate lease agreements with 5% annual escalation, full GST input tax credit for tenants.
  - **Sale**: Freehold outright sale deed, 100% clear NA industrial title, 6–8% net rental yield, 90-day possession.
- **URL**: https://www.metrodevelopers.co.in/metro-industrial-park

### 2. Metro Industrial Park 2 (MIP 2 — Industrial Plots "Build Your Own Shed" — Changodar)
- **Location**: Directly opposite Metro Industrial Park 1, Moraiya, Changodar, Ahmedabad – 382213, Gujarat.
- **Coordinates**: 22.9138011, 72.4212934
- **Campus Details**: 23 clear-title industrial plots | Sizes: 312 to 1,930 sq.yards (2,808 to 17,370 sq.ft).
- **Core Facilities**: Wide Heavy RCC roads, Street lights, Puran (ground leveling & compaction done), compound wall, 24/7 gated security (no CCTV).
- **URL**: https://www.metrodevelopers.co.in/metro-industrial-estate

### 3. Metro Industrial Park 3 (MIP 3 — Plotted Industrial Estate — Bavla – Rajoda Road)
- **Location**: Bavla – Rajoda Road, Bavla, Ahmedabad – 382220, Gujarat, India.
- **Coordinates**: 22.8443566, 72.3762037
- **Campus Details**: 59,508 sq.yards (~60,000 SQYD) | 77 industrial plots | Sizes: 300 to 2,876 sq.yards (2,700 to 25,884 sq.ft).
- **Current Status**: Bookings OPEN across all 77 plots | Puran (ground filling & mechanical leveling) ONGOING on-site | Land possession SOON.
- **Core Facilities**: 18.00-meter (~60 Ft) main crossover boulevard, 12.00-meter internal spine roads, LED streetlights, compound wall, 24/7 gated security (no CCTV).
- **URL**: https://www.metrodevelopers.co.in/metro-industrial-park-3

### 4. Metro Arcade (Highway Commercial Showrooms & Retail)
